summary: Learn advanced strategies for long-term disaster recovery. Equip your organization for resilience. Enroll now!
lede: Long-term disaster recovery brings impact assessment, reconstruction planning and resilience goals together after a catastrophic event. For senior professionals overseeing recovery and reconstruction, the course develops practical skills in sectoral needs assessment, sustainable financing and community-led governance, as well as planning resilient infrastructure and monitoring recovery progress.
audienceIntro: This advanced program is tailored for senior professionals responsible for the strategic oversight and operational execution of large-scale recovery and reconstruction initiatives.
modules: Post-Disaster Needs Assessment and Data Analytics
Economic Recovery and Sustainable Financing Models
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of five years of experience in emergency management, urban planning, or public administration. A basic understanding of the disaster management cycle is required. No prior coding knowledge is needed, though familiarity with spreadsheet software for data analysis is recommended.
